text: Bitcoin and Ethereum are both in modest decline, with Ethereum's 3.1% drop outpacing Bitcoin's 1.9%, suggesting weakening confidence in altseason prospects. Fear & Greed remains firmly in fear territory at 27, though the 4-point weekly rise hints at slight stabilization rather than deepening panic. Bitcoin dominance at 56.2% reflects a flight-to-safety dynamic, though the $64B 24-hour volume is moderate, indicating the selloff lacks conviction rather than representing capitulation.
